title: Research: certify the cleanup minimum and handoff windows for PR #2226's 32 low lenders

body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR2226 exhibits a successful early cleanup for 32 low lenders. This adds the fixed-alphabet necessity proof and exact timing contract needed to preserve it when compiling or retiming the word.

Every one of the 48 retained operations is necessary to restore all 32 original dirty inputs: 32 subtractions and 16 negations. For exactly k restored rows, the sharp local minimum is `C(k)=k+max(0,k-16)`. The 96 component cases certify all 2^48 subsets. Each subtraction also requires one of 32 distinct rank-three-to-four source promotions, already included in the predecessor's bill.

Five subtractions must precede their sources' handoffs, which occur before their own lenders' handoffs: 277<-281 and 282<-285 by cut 1142; 346<-349, 357<-361 and 362<-365 by cut 1054. The original earliest schedule is valid. The latest permitted schedule has the same complete 624-row free-operator B prefix, `Y+=X`, all 80 handoffs, and the same frame endpoints and prefix bill. The proof covers all intermediate cut assignments, not just those two tests.

This is a **finite certificate and scoped proof/audit** in `research/anticipatory-lender-cleanup/`. It fixes the 48-operation alphabet, coefficients, original input labels, monotone frame paths, and operand withdrawal at handoff. It is not an unrestricted circuit minimum or an admission of a partial subset as a supplier. No scalar saving, new paid-profile improvement or kappa is claimed. Final inverse cleanup/private buffers, exact native phases, inverse transpose, whole-call ownership, complete supplier invoice, precision/tape and all-size/outer obligations remain unchecked.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/anticipatory-lender-cleanup --check-only
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/anticipatory-lender-cleanup
python3 -I -O -B research/anticipatory-lender-cleanup/verify.py
```

CPython 3.12.3/Linux, standard library, about 2 seconds for direct replay. The metadata/pin check and registered optimized replay pass after rebasing. RESULT.json records all 64 independently bound lender/source rows, the complete subset distribution, all timing intervals, and the two complete prefix comparisons.

136 semantic rejection cases cover omitted/reordered cleanup, early frame visits, source withdrawal, equal-rank wrong axes, wrong original-input labels, and missing/wrong-sign compensation. 34 positive schedule/basis cases pass. A separate Git-free read-only relocated package passes both normal and optimized Python without changing any file. Source-byte corruption, proof-relevant boolean-to-integer receipt mutation, duplicate JSON keys and overwriting an existing recorded result reject. The format-patch applies to an isolated index at final main and reconstructs the committed tree exactly.

The catalogue's ceiling positive control and selected-baseline binding check passed during orientation. No predecessor full replay, selected supplier cold replay, native phase/dual execution, final cleanup, hosted CI or independent human review is claimed. Successful finite checks are not a formal verification of the full multiplication theorem.

## Open next questions

The README and TASK.json identify two bounded next steps: change one cleanup source/frame/reference premise and fully price the replacement, or source-match a native prefix and verify both orientations plus final cleanup. This account's PR2394 concerns different successor words and cannot be silently substituted. Global ownership and a favorable completed bill remain blockers. This is a completed audit, not a decision to expand that construction family.
